  DATE:       July 29, 1987

  SUBJECT:    RESTAURANT EQUIPMENT




  The present procedure for the Department' acceptance of
  existing restaurant equipment is for a letter containing
  a list of the equipment to be submitted and reviewed by MEA.
  This letter is stamped "Accepted" upon verification by the
  Office and copies distributed to the owners and Borough
  Offices on approval.

  The MEA Division letter. together with the Fire Department
  Ansul System letter presented to the Plumbing Division
  inspector, constitute the final requirements for issuance
  of a Gas Card.

  With the increase publications of the accepted equipment,
  the following procedures will be instituted on August 3, 1987:

  1. The letters from restaurant owners for equipment
     certification prior to the sign-off by the Plumbing
     Division will be referred to the Borough Offices
     for processing.

  2.    This letter shall contain a list of the type of
        equipment, manufacturers' names, model numbers and
        MEA number with a statement notarized by the owner
        authorizing agent that the "above equipment is entirely
        new and represents the only equipment being installed
        and operated in the restaurant".


                                        -1-
3. Letters submitted by architects and engineers shall be
   countersigned and notarized by the owners as indicated
   in Item #2.

4.   Recent vintage used equipment with model and serial
     numbers from the manufacturers may be accepted by the
     MEA Division.

5. When an existing restaurant with "grandfathered" equip-
   ment closes or changes ownership, the existing equipment
   will be declared illegal for the new Pawner, since no
   determination can now be made of the safety situation
   with the older equipment which was probably never tested
   and whose condition is at best questionable.

6.   Checks of MEA acceptance will be required to be made by
     the Examiner and Plumbing Inspector as customarily done
     in the official review of other applications.
